verdict.rationale: Postman's environments concept is referenced indirectly — CLI can search 'environments' as a first-class element (postman-docs-34), and community users confirm using Postman to test/validate APIs 'across our environments' (postman-comm-19) with environment-stored secrets/keys (postman-comm-4) — but no first-party doc in the pack explicitly describes creating/switching between dev, staging, and prod environment variable sets. Missing for 10: explicit product documentation on environment creation, variable scoping, and the UI switcher for selecting an active environment.
